content: Hi, I'm honestly pretty scared right now. My 15-year-old is failing Algebra II at 58% and the final is in six weeks, and I'm worried they're falling behind for good. I only have about 15 minutes before my shift, so could you tell me straight up what the Cedarbridge Live Math Bootcamp would actually do for a kid who's this far behind?

Hi, I’m Maya. I’m sorry to hear you’re worried about your teen’s Algebra II grade.

Our Live Math Bootcamp offers 60‑minute, live, small‑group (3‑8 students) classes taught by certified teachers. The curriculum reviews the current Algebra II unit, reinforces fractions, ratios and equation‑solving skills, and includes test‑prep practice. Parents receive a written progress report every two weeks.

You can choose the Standard plan (8 sessions/month $49) or Plus (12 sessions/month $59). After enrollment, the first class is scheduled at least 14 days later, so you’d have a few weeks of support before the final. There’s no guarantee of a grade change, and the six‑month minimum commitment still applies.

If you’d like to enroll, you can start here: cedarbridgelearninglabs.example/enroll. Let me know if you have any other quick questions!
Honestly, I'm scared we've left it too late and they'll fail the final anyway. Does Cedarbridge Live Math Bootcamp actually work for a kid who is this far behind?

I understand the timing feels tight. Our bootcamp can give your teen focused review of the current Algebra II topics, extra practice on fractions and equation solving, and test‑prep strategies—all in live, small‑group sessions with a certified teacher. In a 2025 parent survey, 68 % reported their child felt more comfortable with fractions and equations after eight weeks, but we have no independent data linking our classes to specific grades or test scores.

Because the first class can’t start until at least 14 days after enrollment, you’d have a few weeks of extra help before the final, but we can’t guarantee a passing mark. If you think that support would be useful, you can enroll via cedarbridgelearninglabs.example/enroll. Let me know if you’d like more details on the plans or scheduling.

Okay, thank you, that's more honest than I expected. But six months minimum commitment? I can't do that, last year I got stuck in a gym contract I couldn't cancel. And the Plus plan is $59 with the 12 sessions, so is there any extra fee on top of that? Can I cancel month to month, and what's the refund policy if it doesn't help?

The price you see is all‑in: $59 /month for the Plus plan (12 live sessions) and includes all fees and tax—no hidden charges.

Plans are billed monthly in advance, but there is a **six‑month minimum commitment**. If you cancel any time during those first six months, you’ll still be billed until the six‑month term ends; after that, the plan switches to month‑to‑month and you can cancel with no further obligation.

Refunds: you can get a full refund of the **first month’s** payment if you request it within 7 days of signup **and** you’ve attended no more than one class. After that, no refunds (including for partial months) apply.

If you decide to enroll, you can start at cedarbridgelearninglabs.example/enroll. Let me know if you need anything else!

So if I'm reading that right, I'd be locked in for six months at $59 a month, which is $354 total, and if it doesn't help after the first month I only get that month back if I ask within 7 days and my kid has attended one class at most. That's a lot of money to risk on something I can't verify, and I'm already stretched. I'm going to talk to my teen tonight and look at the free homework club and a couple of other options first, so I'll leave this undecided for now. Thank you for being straight with me.
